works.author: Rode, Pierre
works.title: Caprice No. 1 in C major
works.level_basis: RCM 2021 Level 9 etude list; Henle HN 1186 rates it 4/9; Strauss: set sits between Kreutzer and Dont
works.contents: Cantabile 3/4, then Moderato 12/8. Slow expressive introduction (bow-speed control for swells); main section with elastic martelé at the tip, trills, equal strength in down- and up-bows (Strauss; Yang DMA 2006; The Etude 1902)
works.notes: Cantabile intro, then martelé at the tip with trills; equal up- and down-bow strokes
works.edition: Henle Urtext HN 1186 (ed. N. Gertsch); first editions Frey (Paris) and Peters (Leipzig), [1819] per IMSLP
works.imslp_page: 24 Caprices for Solo Violin, Op.22 (Rode, Pierre)

works.author: Rode, Pierre
works.title: Caprice No. 2 in A minor
works.level_basis: RCM 2021 Level 9 etude list; Henle HN 1186 rates it 4/9
works.contents: Allegretto 6/8. Needs more energy than the marking suggests: upper-half bowing, fast bow speed on the fortepianos, string crossings by circular wrist motion; left hand thinks in double stops
works.notes: Energetic upper-half bowing; fortepiano bow speed; string crossings in double-stop patterns
works.edition: Henle Urtext HN 1186 (ed. N. Gertsch); first editions Frey (Paris) and Peters (Leipzig), [1819] per IMSLP

works.author: Rode, Pierre
works.title: Caprice No. 3 in G major
works.level_basis: RCM 2021 Level 9 etude list; Henle HN 1186 rates it 4/9
works.contents: Comodo 3/4. Played entirely in second position; warm, even, fluid legato with the bow weaving between the strings; fingers kept down where possible
works.notes: All in 2nd position; even, fluid legato; bow weaves between the strings
works.edition: Henle Urtext HN 1186 (ed. N. Gertsch); first editions Frey (Paris) and Peters (Leipzig), [1819] per IMSLP

works.author: Rode, Pierre
works.title: Caprice No. 4 in E minor
works.level_basis: RCM 2021 Level 10 etude list; Henle HN 1186 rates it 5/9
works.contents: Siciliano 6/8, then Allegro (common time). Legato Siciliano with strings of thirds; small martelé at the tip (mm. 19-20); the Allegro exercises 3rd and 4th fingers and shifts up the D string to the 4th finger (Strauss; Strad review)
works.notes: Siciliano with strings of thirds; fast Allegro works 3rd/4th fingers; martelé at the tip
works.edition: Henle Urtext HN 1186 (ed. N. Gertsch); first editions Frey (Paris) and Peters (Leipzig), [1819] per IMSLP

works.author: Rode, Pierre
works.title: Caprice No. 5 in D major
works.level_basis: RCM 2021 Level 9 etude list; Henle HN 1186 rates it 5/9
works.contents: Moderato (common time). Detaché and martelé combinations (dotted sixteenths as martelé) with string crossings; bow stays on the string; bow speed, distribution and frequent dynamic changes (Strauss; Yang DMA 2006)
works.notes: Détaché and martelé with string crossings; bow distribution; bow stays on the string
works.edition: Henle Urtext HN 1186 (ed. N. Gertsch); first editions Frey (Paris) and Peters (Leipzig), [1819] per IMSLP

works.title: Caprice No. 6 in B minor
works.level_basis: RCM 2021 Level 10 etude list; Henle HN 1186 rates it 5/9
works.contents: Adagio 3/4, then Moderato (cut time). Tenor aria on the G string with slow shifts; the Moderato brings scales and broken triads in all keys in broad détaché, with big leaps (mm. 37, 39)
works.notes: G-string cantilena with slow shifts; scales and broken triads in broad détaché
works.edition: Henle Urtext HN 1186 (ed. N. Gertsch); first editions Frey (Paris) and Peters (Leipzig), [1819] per IMSLP

existing_issues.issue: Title lacks IMSLP's opus and subtitle: IMSLP page '24 Caprices for Solo Violin, Op.22' (work title '24 Caprices for Violin', alternative 'Caprices en forme d'études'); original title '24 Caprices en forme d'études pour le violon seul dans les 24 tons de la gamme'. Op. 22 is the IMSLP/Wikipedia number (the Henle, Peters and Schott listings carry no opus). Level 7 is fine for the complete set (the 24 individual caprices come out at 5-7, median 6). Set is empty: use '24 Caprices' so the whole-book row groups with the 24 new rows. data/imslp-pages.json has no page for id 656: add '24 Caprices for Solo Violin, Op.22 (Rode, Pierre)'.

Exams string 'Henle 4–7' should read 'Henle 4–6': Henle HN 1186 rates the caprices 4 to 6 on its 1–9 scale. RCM 9 (mvt) / RCM 10 (mvt) are confirmed by the RCM 2021 syllabus (Level 9: one of Nos. 1-3, 5, 8, 10; Level 10: one of Nos. 4, 6, 7, 9, 11-24). ASTA CAP 9/10 and AMEB Gr 7/8 could not be re-checked (CAP handbook is members-only, AMEB site blocks automated access); the AMEB Series 9 Grade 7 book contains 'Vivacissimo (Rode)' = Caprice No. 17 in a piano arrangement.

new_authors_found: Baillot, Pierre — co-author with Rode and Kreutzer of the Conservatoire Méthode de violon and author of L'Art du violon (both on IMSLP); core French-school pedagogy for a methods researcher
Rostal, Max — editor of Schott ED 6512 (Rode caprices) with his own preparatory exercises for each of the 24 caprices; check his other technical editions
note: RODE SLICE. Complete and checked against IMSLP page '24 Caprices for Solo Violin, Op.22 (Rode, Pierre)' (https://imslp.org/wiki/24_Caprices_for_Solo_Violin,_Op.22_(Rode,_Pierre)); the page has no per-caprice key list. KEYS of all 24 agree on three sources: Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/24_Caprices_for_Violin_(Rode), also the tempo markings), the Peters listing at Salão Musical (https://www.salaomusical.com/gb/violin/3955-rode-24-capricen-for-violin-peters-9790014003623.html) and Henle HN 1186 (https://www.henle.de/24-Caprices-for-Violin-solo/HN-1186). TECHNIQUE notes: Axel Strauss, 'How to Play the Rode Caprices', Strings, Aug 2010 (https://cdn.naxos.com/sharedfiles/PDF/How_to_Play_Rode_Caprices.pdf: all 24 numbers; says the set 'fits well between' Kreutzer and Dont), Semi Yang DMA thesis 'Violin Etudes: A Pedagogical Guide', Cincinnati 2006 (original title; Nos. 1, 5, 12; https://etd.ohiolink.edu/acprod/odb_etd/ws/send_file/send?accession=ucin1146083212&disposition=inline), The Etude May 1902 on No. 1 (https://etudemagazine.com/etude/1902/05/the-rode-studies-1.html), Strad review (https://www.thestrad.com/rode-24-caprices-en-forme-detudes/4597.article; Nos. 4, 8, 15, 18, 22) and MusicWeb review (http://www.musicweb-international.com/classrev/2010/Feb10/Rode_8570958.htm; No. 23). LEVELS: RCM 2021 violin syllabus (https://teacherportal.rcmusic.com/getattachment/80aafd06-c977-4d10-8b2e-8009211afd1d/s50_violin-syllabus-2021_online_f.pdf): Level 9 etudes p. 67 'one of nos. 1-3, 5, 8, 10'; Level 10 etudes p. 74 'one of nos. 4, 6, 7, 9, 11-24'; Level 10 List C p. 72 No. 17 (arr. ten Have). Henle gives each caprice 4-6 of 9. Rule used: RCM Level 9 = 5, Level 10 = 6, plus 1 where Henle rates 6 (Nos. 7, 16, 19, 20, 23). Result: six caprices at 5 (Nos. 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 10), thirteen at 6, five at 7 (so the whole book at 7 is the top of the range, median 6). AMEB Series 9 Grade 7 grade book lists 'Vivacissimo (Rode)' (https://musicjunction.com.au/products/ameb-violin-grade-7-series-9); matched to No. 17 by its unique tempo marking, not printed with a number. WELL_KNOWN = true for the six RCM Level 9 entry studies (1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 10), No. 7 (the set's only staccato study), No. 19 (its octave study), and Nos. 13 and 17 (arranged and played as pieces: Elman's Etude mélodique; ten Have, RCM List C, AMEB); judgement call, not a survey. NOT CHECKED: ASTA CAP lists (members-only handbook), AMEB manual lists (site returns 403), Naxos pages (403), ABRSM; Trinity 2026 violin diploma list has no Rode. Henle's own page and the RCM PDF were read directly. PUBLICATION DATE is disputed: IMSLP 1819 (Bibliographie de la France, 13 Mar 1819), Wikipedia 1813 (Stowell), Strad/MusicWeb/Yang c. 1815, Schott 'first Paris edition of 1820'. OTHER RODE TECHNICAL PUBLICATION: '12 Études' (posthumous), added as one new whole-book row (level 7, medium confidence; no syllabus found; keys from the Naxos 8.572604 track list, e.g. https://www.europadisc.co.uk/classical/96227/no.2%20in%20C%20major.htm). TOOLING GAP FOR ALL RESEARCHERS: scripts/expand/imslp_author.py lists only direct members of Category:<Author>; works filed in Category:<Author>/Collections or /Collected Works are missed (this is why Rode's 24 Caprices and 12 Études, and Fiorillo's '36 Caprices for Violin, Op.3', do not appear in its output). Query those subcategories too.
